dct_title_s: Bain's railway map of South Africa
dct_description_sm: Map of South Africa indicating which railway lines were in operation, which were under construction and which had been authorised.
Bar scale on map given in "Miles."
Shows cities, towns, roads and rivers, the mail routes and steamer routes (with distances in miles).
"Through all booksellers or from John G. Bain, St. George's Hotel Buildings, Church Street, Cape Town, C.C."

Insets maps: Railways around Johannesburg. Scale [ca. 1:950 400] -- Natal railways. Scale [ca. 1:4 828 032] -- The Cape Peninsula. Scale [ca. 1:402 336] -- [Africa] -- Untitled inset map showing the northern extension of the railway lines from Mafeking to Bulawayo, Salisbury [Harare], Mazoe and Umtali [Mutare] in Rhodesia [Zimbabwe], and to Beira in Portuguese East Africa [Mozambique].
This copy has handwritten annotations at bottom right.
